entities.summary: Jayme Henrique Chemello was a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate. He was appointed auxiliary bishop of Pelotas and titular bishop of Bisica in 1969 and then bishop of Pelotas in 1977. He died in Pelotas on 29 August 2025, at the age of 93.
